claim_updates.reason: No LLM agent inheritance vs cold/retrieval/SPIDER tested. Quantitative within-store prerequisite replicates parent exactly: 192 tasks, 49 templates, 36 families >=3 (34 >=4) enabling 2-train/1-test hold-out, duplication 0.9479 (182/192, CI [0.9167,0.9792]) decomposed to exact-copy 0.0781 (15/192, CI [0.0417,0.1198]) leaving 91.8% parameterized variation (167/182), param_task 0.8958 (172/192, CI [0.8490,0.9375]) and param_template 0.8367 (41/49) exceeding frozen thresholds (>=0.5 reuse, >=0.3 param, <0.2 copy), PC1_WEB_SEARCH PASS via REUSED parent (combobox Search + button Search, 1426 nodes task 514) and PC2_MIND2WEB_RECURRENCE PASS (max cluster 151). However identifiable same-mechanism transfer at element-pattern level not demonstrated: frozen AX_consistency threshold >=0.6 requires 15 tasks 2-per-family live CDP at 1280x720, but ax_consistency=null, 10 REUSED trees 1-per-family (tasks 25,514,519,434,468,506,794,673,532,654), playwright_installed false. Per frozen decision_rule clause 1, missing AX measurement triggers FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for within-store hold-out viability, not PARTIAL PASS. Claim remains EXPERIMENTAL bounded to quantitative census substrate only; element-pattern verification and LLM benefit pending.

No cross-site transfer tested. Mind2Web cross-website same-mechanism overlap measurement on this run is INCONCLUSIVE due to three critical divergences flagged by audit REVISE: (1) mechanism definition diverged from frozen TF-IDF text + k-means (k=min(50,unique_tasks/20) fitted train-only) to coarse keyword heuristic (action_type-target_role-verb_lemma) yielding only 33 distinct train /27 test_website mechanisms (duplication 0.9911) inflating both true overlap 0.7407 and null mean 0.6942; (2) official HF splits train/test_task/test_website/test_domain not used — HF osunlp/Mind2Web in environment has only single split train (1009 tasks, 73 websites, 3 domains vs spec 137/31, dataset_revision unknown) and producer fabricated splits by deterministic 60/40 random shuffle of sorted websites/domains (595 train /414 test_website /748 test_domain are artifacts); (3) shuffle null B4/NC2 mis-specified as concatenated label shuffle with random split_point 1..n_train (null_mean 0.6942 p95 0.8929 excess 0.0466 <0.10 threshold, true not exceeding p95) not website-label permutation as frozen. Recomputed coarse metrics replicated (0.7407, null 0.6942, excess 0.0466) but spec-compliant overlap/shuffle null = null. High null reflects coarse clustering, not website sharing. No inference that true cross-website transfer is falsified is justified; Mind2Web measurable overlap remains UNKNOWN pending spec-compliant remeasurement. WebArena cross-store remains vacuous null (single store).
